THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
ORDER UNDER SECTION 39 A (1)

THE allotments specified in the Order No. 199 of 2015 made underthe Proviso (a) to Section 38 of the Land Acquisition Act(Chapter 460) and published in the Gazette Extra OrdinaryNo. 1944/6 dated 07.12.2015 is vested absolutely in the State andthe possession of which has been taken for or on behalf of the Stateunder Para (a) of Section 40 of the aforesaid Act. But by the virtue ofpowers vested in me by Sub-section (1) of Section 39(a) (inserted byAct, No. 8 of 1979) of the Land Acquisition Act. I, GayanthaKarunatilleke, Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms,do hereby divest only the allotment described in the Schedule 1below.
Gayantha Karunatilleke,Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms.
My No.: 4-3/10/2012/LRB/186.Acquiring Officer No.: WGSWD&EIP/ACQ/DW/05.Ministry of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms,“Mihikatha Medura”,Rajamalwatta Avenue,Battaramulla.29th October, 2019.
